name: DFD_Microsoft 365 Defender Alerts (automatically generated)
xql_query:
// ============================================================
// Rule: DFD_Microsoft 365 Defender Alerts (automatically generated)
// Vendor: Microsoft Defender
// Objective:
// Detect activity associated with DFD_Microsoft 365 Defender Alerts (automatically generated).
// Severity: SEV_040_HIGH
// Category: OTHER
// ============================================================
// MITRE ATT&CK:
// Tactic: TA0002 - Execution
// Technique: T1035 - Service Execution

// Severidade em nível de incidente: High | Critical
// Exclui status Resolved para foco em alertas ativos
 
dataset = microsoft_365_defender_generic_alert_raw
| filter _alert_data != null
| filter severity in ("High", "Critical")
| filter status != "Resolved"
| filter (`incidentName` not in ("""User restricted from sending email involving one user""", """User restricted from sending email""", "Purview IRM"))
 and not (`incidentName` contains "Purview IRM")
 
// =========================
// CAMPOS DO INCIDENTE
// =========================
| alter
    incident_id          = coalesce(to_string(incidentId), "N/A"),
    incident_name        = coalesce(incidentName, "N/A"),
    incident_severity    = coalesce(severity, "N/A"),
    incident_link        = coalesce(incidentUri, "N/A"),
    incident_created     = coalesce(createdTime, "N/A"),
    incident_updated     = coalesce(lastUpdateTime, "N/A"),
    incident_first_act   = coalesce(First_activity, "N/A"),
    incident_last_act    = coalesce(Last_activity, "N/A"),
    incident_categories  = coalesce(to_string(Categories), "N/A"),
    incident_det_sources = coalesce(to_string(Detection_sources), "N/A"),
    incident_svc_sources = coalesce(to_string(Service_sources), "N/A"),
    incident_impacted    = coalesce(to_string(Impacted_entities), "N/A")
 
// =========================
// ALERTA PRINCIPAL (índice 0)
// =========================
| alter _alert_arr = json_extract_array(alerts, "$")
| alter _alert_obj = arrayindex(_alert_arr, 0)
 
| alter
    alert_id             = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_alert_obj, "$.alertId"), "N/A"),
    alert_title          = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_alert_obj, "$.title"), "N/A"),
    alert_description    = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_alert_obj, "$.description"), "N/A"),
    alert_severity       = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_alert_obj, "$.severity"), "N/A"),
    alert_category       = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_alert_obj, "$.category"), "N/A"),
    alert_status         = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_alert_obj, "$.status"), "N/A"),
    alert_detection_src  = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_alert_obj, "$.detectionSource"), "N/A"),
    alert_service_src    = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_alert_obj, "$.serviceSource"), "N/A"),
    alert_investigation  = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_alert_obj, "$.investigationState"), "N/A"),
    alert_classification = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_alert_obj, "$.classification"), "N/A"),
    alert_determination  = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_alert_obj, "$.determination"), "N/A"),
    alert_actor          = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_alert_obj, "$.actorName"), "N/A"),
    alert_threat_family  = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_alert_obj, "$.threatFamilyName"), "N/A"),
    alert_first_activity = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_alert_obj, "$.firstActivity"), "N/A"),
    alert_last_activity  = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_alert_obj, "$.lastActivity"), "N/A"),
    alert_creation_time  = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_alert_obj, "$.creationTime"), "N/A"),
    alert_mitre          = coalesce(to_string(json_extract_array(_alert_obj, "$.mitreTechniques")), "N/A"),
    _entities            = json_extract_array(_alert_obj, "$.entities")
 
// =========================
// FILTRA ENTIDADES DO ARRAY _entities
// Usa "@element" como placeholder do item atual
// =========================
| alter
    _ent_user      = arrayfilter(_entities, json_extract_scalar("@element", "$.entityType") = "User"),
    _ent_device    = arrayfilter(_entities, json_extract_scalar("@element", "$.entityType") = "Device"),
    _ent_ip        = arrayfilter(_entities, json_extract_scalar("@element", "$.entityType") = "Ip"),
    _ent_mailbox   = arrayfilter(_entities, json_extract_scalar("@element", "$.entityType") = "Mailbox"),
    _ent_mail      = arrayfilter(_entities, json_extract_scalar("@element", "$.entityType") = "MailMessage"),
    _ent_cloudapp  = arrayfilter(_entities, json_extract_scalar("@element", "$.entityType") = "CloudApplication")
 
// =========================
// PEGA O PRIMEIRO OBJETO DE CADA TIPO
// E CONVERTE PARA STRING JSON
// =========================
| alter
    _user_obj      = to_json_string(arrayindex(_ent_user, 0)),
    _device_obj    = to_json_string(arrayindex(_ent_device, 0)),
    _ip_obj        = to_json_string(arrayindex(_ent_ip, 0)),
    _mailbox_obj   = to_json_string(arrayindex(_ent_mailbox, 0)),
    _mail_obj      = to_json_string(arrayindex(_ent_mail, 0)),
    _cloudapp_obj  = to_json_string(arrayindex(_ent_cloudapp, 0))
 
// =========================
// USUÁRIO
// =========================
| alter
    user_upn       = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_user_obj, "$.userPrincipalName"), "N/A"),
    user_account   = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_user_obj, "$.accountName"), "N/A"),
    user_domain    = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_user_obj, "$.domainName"), "N/A"),
    user_sid       = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_user_obj, "$.userSid"), "N/A"),
    user_aad_id    = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_user_obj, "$.aadUserId"), "N/A"),
    user_verdict   = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_user_obj, "$.verdict"), "N/A")
 
// =========================
// DISPOSITIVO
// =========================
| alter
    device_name    = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_device_obj, "$.deviceDnsName"), "N/A"),
    device_id      = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_device_obj, "$.mdatpDeviceId"), "N/A"),
    device_os      = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_device_obj, "$.osPlatform"), "N/A"),
    device_risk    = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_device_obj, "$.riskScore"), "N/A")
 
// =========================
// IP
// =========================
| alter
    src_ip         = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_ip_obj, "$.ipAddress"), "N/A"),
    ip_verdict     = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_ip_obj, "$.verdict"), "N/A")
 
// =========================
// MAILBOX
// =========================
| alter
    mailbox_addr   = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_mailbox_obj, "$.mailboxAddress"), "N/A"),
    mailbox_upn    = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_mailbox_obj, "$.userPrincipalName"), "N/A")
 
// =========================
// E-MAIL
// =========================
| alter
    mail_subject   = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_mail_obj, "$.subject"), "N/A"),
    mail_rcpt      = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_mail_obj, "$.recipient"), "N/A"),
    mail_msg_id    = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_mail_obj, "$.internetMessageId"), "N/A"),
    mail_delivery  = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_mail_obj, "$.deliveryAction"), "N/A")
 
// =========================
// CLOUD APPLICATION
// =========================
| alter
    cloudapp_name  = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_cloudapp_obj, "$.applicationName"), "N/A"),
    cloudapp_verdict = coalesce(json_extract_scalar(_cloudapp_obj, "$.verdict"), "N/A")
 
// =========================
// DESCRIÇÃO FINAL
// Sem null (usa campos já normalizados com N/A)
// =========================
| alter alert_description_generated = concat(
    coalesce(alert_title, incident_name, "Alerta sem título"), " | ",
 
    "Categoria: ", alert_category, " | ",
    "Status: ", coalesce(alert_status, alert_status, "N/A"), " | ",
    "Investigação: ", alert_investigation, " | ",
    "Classificação: ", alert_classification, " | ",
    "Determinação: ", alert_determination, " | ",
 
    "Fonte: ", coalesce(alert_service_src, _vendor, "N/A"),
    " (", alert_detection_src, ") | ",
 
    "Usuário: ", coalesce(user_upn, user_account, "N/A"), " | ",
    "Domínio: ", user_domain, " | ",
    "Veredicto Usuário: ", user_verdict, " | ",
 
    "Dispositivo: ", device_name, " | ",
    "OS: ", device_os, " | ",
    "Risco Dispositivo: ", device_risk, " | ",
 
    "IP: ", src_ip, " [verdict: ", ip_verdict, "] | ",
 
    "Mailbox: ", coalesce(mailbox_addr, mailbox_upn, "N/A"), " | ",
    "E-mail Assunto: ", mail_subject, " | ",
    "Destinatário: ", mail_rcpt, " | ",
    "Entrega: ", mail_delivery, " | ",
 
    "Aplicação em Nuvem: ", cloudapp_name, " [verdict: ", cloudapp_verdict, "] | ",
 
    "Ameaça/Ator: ", coalesce(alert_threat_family, alert_actor, "N/A"), " | ",
    "MITRE: ", alert_mitre, " | ",
 
    "Primeira Atividade: ", coalesce(alert_first_activity, incident_first_act, "N/A"), " | ",
    "Última Atividade: ", coalesce(alert_last_activity, incident_last_act, "N/A"), " | ",
 
    "Entidades Impactadas: ", incident_impacted, " | ",
    "Detalhes: ", alert_description, " | ",
    "Link Incidente: ", incident_link
)
 
// =========================
// CAMPOS FINAIS
// =========================
| fields
    _time,
 
    incident_id, incident_name, incident_severity, alert_status,
    incident_link, incident_created, incident_updated,
    incident_first_act, incident_last_act,
    incident_impacted, incident_categories, incident_det_sources, incident_svc_sources,
    alert_id, alert_title, alert_severity, alert_category, alert_status,
    alert_investigation, alert_classification, alert_determination,
    alert_detection_src, alert_service_src,
    alert_actor, alert_threat_family, alert_mitre,
    alert_first_activity, alert_last_activity, alert_creation_time,
 
    user_upn, user_account, user_domain, user_sid, user_aad_id, user_verdict,
    device_name, device_id, device_os, device_risk,
    src_ip, ip_verdict,
    mailbox_addr, mailbox_upn,
    mail_subject, mail_rcpt, mail_msg_id, mail_delivery,
    cloudapp_name, cloudapp_verdict,
 
    _vendor, _product,
    alert_description_generated
description: Correlation para gerar alertas automaticamente com os logs do MS Defender
